utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m still organizing the Saturday front porch repair drive, and I could really use a few more helpers. I’ll try to round up a couple more people too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate you helping round up a few more people, and I’ll see you at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many helpers do you need, and what time should they come by?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m aiming for about three or four helpers, and Saturday morning around 9 would be best. Thanks, Mina — that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can help with the repair drive Saturday on the front porch—just remind me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — please be there by 9 Saturday morning on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still ironing out the logistics for Saturday’s repair drive on the front porch, so a few extra helpers would really make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — that would be a big help. If you can, please stop by the front porch Saturday; we could really use you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many helpers do you still need, and what should they bring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I could use a few more helpers, and if they can bring basic tools and work gloves, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — that would be a big help. Just let me know what time works, and I’ll be there on the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam. Let’s do 10 a.m. on Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still lining up the Saturday porch repair drive, so any help you can bring would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep helping line up a few more hands for Saturday on the front porch.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
